findings.statement: Convergence rank 1 (score 4.5197, 5 streams). Open Targets association score 0.3088, rank 79 of 1998. TCGA tumour-vs-normal log2FC 9.712 (padj 2.58e-30); protein log2FC 2.269. UniProt: cell membrane / microvillus membrane (antibody-accessible). Drugs: GIRENTUXIMAB PHASE_3, IODINE I 124 GIRENTUXIMAB PHASE_2, SULTHIAME PHASE_4, ETHOXZOLAMIDE WITHDRAWAL. DepMap: ccRCC mean effect 0.051, 0 of 24 lines dependent, so it is a surface/imaging target and biomarker, not a survival dependency.

Convergence rank 3 (score 4.2143). Open Targets association score 0.0572. TCGA log2FC 7.09 (padj 6.45e-25); protein log2FC 2.421. UniProt: cell membrane ligand of CD27. Drugs: CUSATUZUMAB PHASE_2, VORSETUZUMAB PHASE_1, VORSETUZUMAB MAFODOTIN PHASE_1, MDX-1411 PHASE_1. DepMap ccRCC mean effect 0.251, so no intrinsic dependency; it is an antibody/ADC/immune target, tractable but untested clinically in this analysis.

Convergence rank 7 (score 3.9643). TCGA log2FC 4.685 (padj 5.62e-27); protein log2FC 2.709; Cox log HR 0.301 (padj 0.00479, higher expression linked to worse survival). Open Targets score 0.0598, no drugs listed. DepMap ccRCC mean effect 0.316 (no dependency). Association/prognostic biomarker, weak target case.

Convergence rank 5 (score 4.1052); Open Targets association 0.4049 (genetic association component 0.519). TCGA log2FC 3.989 (padj 1.43e-31); protein log2FC 1.837. No drugs in the ranking row; predicted tractability only. DepMap ccRCC mean effect 0.002, selectivity -0.021, so no dependency: tractable-but-untested, weak target case.

Convergence rank 2 (score 4.2206). Down in tumour: TCGA log2FC -4.741 (padj 6.57e-11); protein log2FC -2.273. Cox log HR -0.358 (padj 0.000023), higher expression associated with better survival. Open Targets score 0.0701; no drugs. DepMap mean effect 0.156, so a loss-type biomarker rather than target.

Convergence rank 4 (score 4.1667). Down in tumour: TCGA log2FC -6.154 (padj 5.42e-13); protein log2FC -2.264. Cox log HR -0.402. Drugs: PROBENECID PHASE_4, PRATOSARTAN PHASE_3 (transporter substrates/inhibitors, not tumour-directed). Open Targets score 0.0662. DepMap mean effect -0.019: no dependency. Proximal-tubule loss marker.

Established ccRCC target (HIF-2alpha). Open Targets association score 0.4871. Drug: BELZUTIFAN APPROVAL. Tractability: SM approved drug, high-quality ligand. Reactome: Regulation of gene expression by Hypoxia-inducible Factor. DepMap: ccRCC mean effect -0.143 vs other 0.157, selectivity 0.3, 0.208 of 24 lines dependent, padj 0.061, not common essential: selective but partial dependency.

Established ccRCC target. Open Targets association score 0.525. Drug stages include RIDAFOROLIMUS APPROVAL. DepMap: ccRCC mean effect -1.52, all 24 lines dependent (fraction 1.0) but common_essential true, selectivity 0.354: strong dependency with toxicity risk.

Top-2 Open Targets ccRCC association (score 0.6348). Recurrent driver: mutated in 185 of 511 tumours (freq 0.362), obs/exp 43.498, padj 4.59e-239. Association and driver only; no direct drug, loss-of-function context (synthetic-lethal opportunities).
Top Open Targets ccRCC association (score 0.6466). Mutated in 247 of 511 tumours (freq 0.483), padj 0.0; the founding driver whose loss stabilises HIF-2alpha (EPAS1), linking to belzutifan.

caveats: Only genes in the first 12 ranks of convergence_ranking were inspected plus established targets; larger ranking slice exceeded output limits.
DepMap for CA9 and KDR returned null evidence ids; their dependency numbers are quoted from the ranking row where possible.
Drug stage for KDR/MTOR lists include non-selective multi-kinase agents; indication in ccRCC not confirmed by Open Targets.
Open Targets association ranks are disease-wide literature/genetics and not independent of the convergence literature stream.
